test_title: PYST 4: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) IL - FQ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5984b907015d5f16ff9d08b41b2a87d22ebca67473d4f9d5eea254e9e7892a5c.png] 

Option 2) WR - TW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7a7a389b6d40b67d2ff29c16e2abd88f0980ad3b6d509ba4374be64f2335e97.png] 

**Option 3) HY - DD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c56e10f7d3cb9a44b2088ebea32d9e50d74b7d1d82bc695269a7741e24739416.png] 

Option 4) QE - NJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6483c230ad382fa3034203a7aecce0190ccd685aa6876d84367484fdb2431d97.png] 

Here, 'HY-DD' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
